src: colored marker pixels s embedded in the repeated 2x2 tiles
dst: same-color marker endpoint d at the same local tile offset in the same tile row or column
path: straight horizontal or vertical interval from s to d in the 3x3 tile lattice, mapped back to the shared local offset inside each tile
trajectory: recolor each base-color cell on the inclusive interval with the marker color
transform: keep separator lines, original marker pixels, and off-path base cells unchanged
